audit: Frozen Track A feature support/missingness attribution; diagnostic-only, no accuracy claim.

metric_definitions.per_idea_defined_fraction: number of explicit defined=true gap emissions divided by official IDs in that region; false rows remain missing and are not imputed
metric_definitions.estimator_family_mask: union of defined-ID masks for selected ideas in a component sharing the same registered idea family label (for example Dst/G/P/Sc/Sca)
metric_definitions.effective_candidate_component_mask: union of estimator-family masks with strictly positive frozen component weight; A3 F is replaced by the union of its frozen Dawid-Skene witness defined masks
metric_definitions.pairwise_mask_coverage: intersection, union, intersection/region, both directions of conditional coverage, and Jaccard for exact masks; no score values used

source_manifest.candidate_registration_projection: candidate_id/artifact/hash/rows/columns/preregistered-card metadata/parameter_provenance only; score, submission, and leaderboard fields skipped

a3_witness_support.effective_F_defined_mask_rule: union of defined registered covariate masks for frozen Dawid-Skene witnesses; no values refit or predictions rebuilt

source_mask_audit.note: V2 has no selected idea list in final-two; only its registered top-level R/B/POI masks are reported, not rederived or imputed.

limitations: A1/A2/A3 support is attributed to registered selected gap outputs and frozen weights, not interpreted as target accuracy.
any_component_support is only the union of available R/B/POI masks; it is not an A1 Sca5 composite-definedness mask.
V2 has no selected idea list; its three top-level masks are reported separately from A1/A2/A3 estimator-family masks.
A3's F posterior support follows the frozen witness definedness masks; witness accuracy is not assessed.
